name: Battery Saver
description: Hardware resource policy for power-constrained laptops: CPU energy preference biased toward 'balance_power'/'power', power-profiles-daemon mapped to its own 'power-saver' profile, and (informational only, no forced GPU switching) a preference note for integrated graphics on hybrid systems. Only available on hosts with a detected battery — 'serein hardware plan battery' reports profile_available=false with a stated reason on a desktop, it never pretends the profile applies. See docs/hardware/power-policy.md.

rollback.notes: No Apply mechanism exists yet in S2; serein hardware plan is read-only. See docs/hardware/architecture.md for what a future Apply step would need.
